speaker: caller
text: Good morning, this is the fraud department of DBS Bank. We detected unusual withdrawals on your debit card.

speaker: receiver
text: Really? I haven't used my card today.

speaker: caller
text: Your card has been compromised and we must replace it today before more money is taken.

speaker: receiver
text: Okay, how do I get a new card?

speaker: caller
text: For your safety, please don't go to the branch, it is being monitored by the syndicate.

speaker: receiver
text: That's scary. Then what should I do?

speaker: caller
text: Our officer will come to your home within the hour to collect the old card.

speaker: caller
text: Put the card in an envelope and write your PIN on a note inside, so we can cancel it properly.

speaker: receiver
text: My PIN too? Is that normal?

speaker: caller
text: Yes, it's the standard procedure. Also withdraw your cash at the ATM and hand it to the officer for safekeeping.

speaker: receiver
text: I'll call the bank hotline first, thank you.
